founderDecision.channel: relayed by the orchestrator in the track brief; not yet in founder-decisions-20261031.json
founderDecision.implementation: LIMITS diskBytes = 2 GiB and diskFiles = 100000, measured every supervisor poll over the candidate directory plus the per-run TMPDIR (disk blocks, each inode once, every entry counts, links not followed, an unlistable or unsearchable directory counts as over); breach kills and settles the group, then refuses with disk-limit-exceeded. config_dir is not measured.

findings.RV-01: Done. ProbeResult/ContainedHostRun and run_evidence carry escaped_processes (left the group), surviving_processes (alive after the final sweep iteration, including exhaustion) and escaped_descendants. settled stays strict. The T007 judgement change stays with T007.
findings.RV-02: Done. run_probe(..., cancel=threading.Event|None); result.cancelled; non-Event refused invalid-lab-request.
findings.RV-03: Done for the proxy side. EgressProxy.counters() (connections, allowed and allowed:<target>, denied and denied:<reason>, unexpectedDirect, upstreamFailed, bytesUp, bytesDown); per-run delta in result.egress and run_evidence[egress]. Kernel-denied direct attempts never reach the proxy and stay uncounted, as the review says. The verdict is T007's.
findings.RV-16: Done. dedicated-user-unsafe when the account is in admin/wheel (gid 80/0, primary or supplementary), is the console user, or its home is not an owned directory with no group/other bits. AccountFacts (gids, home mode) enter the environment hash via environment_sha256(..., account). Runbook: the dedicated home must be chmod 700 and the code location unreadable by that account (T009 runbook, not code).
findings.RV-20: Partly. The subpath run_root metadata rule is replaced by literals for run_root and the new RUNDIR param (the run directory); candidate and TMPDIR stay covered by their subpath rule. Trimming SYSTEM_READ needs the T009 trace and is not done.
findings.RV-22: Done. Every ancestor and the executable itself must be owned by root or the dedicated user. Consequence: operator-owned installs (Homebrew) are refused, an operator setup step. The installed-in-root-owned-directory stronger form is a runbook item.
findings.RV-23: Done. After the exec-denied case the compile check runs an allow-listed command (fixture: interpreter on an empty program; launch: pinned claude --version) and requires exit 0, else self-check-failed. Risk: claude --version under the profile may fail until the profile has grown at T009; that is a real refusal, not a false one.
findings.RV-29: Done. A dead accept loop (outside close()) marks the proxy unhealthy; the next pre-session closes it and refuses proxy-unavailable, the following attempt restarts it. The SNI-as-defence-in-depth remark is in the EgressProxy docstring. ECH GREASE handling is unchanged.
findings.RV-30: Done. Run and compile directories are removed by _remove_tree, which clears BSD flags and directory modes and retries; cleanupFailed in the result and evidence; leftovers refuse the next run with workspace-leftovers. A child can therefore cause a persistent refusal until an operator removes the leftover.
findings.RV-32: Done as counters. A poll-based lineage (parent pid via proc_bsdinfo) splits leavers into escaped_descendants and unattributed (escaped - descendants); both are killed and both keep settled false.
findings.RV-33: Done for this edit: new hashes recorded here; the stale comment at harness_host_claude.py:47 is outside this track's files and stays for its owner.
findings.RV-18: Out of scope (deferred until T009 observes state paths).
findings.RV-14: Not done here (component hash list and runner binding); the T005 half (adding probes, transport and quota modules to the environment hash) remains open.
